subject: Taxes
title: The $80 Billion Boost
description: A quick, practical guide to The $80 Billion Boost.

hook.text: In 2022, the Inflation Reduction Act gave the IRS $80 billion over 10 years—the largest investment in its history.

buildup.text: The funding targeted enforcement ($45.6B), operations ($25.3B), technology ($4.8B), and taxpayer services ($3.2B).

discovery.text: The CBO estimated the $80 billion would generate $200 billion in new revenue—a $120 billion net return for taxpayers.

twist.text: The new House majority immediately voted to rescind $72 billion of the funding.

climax.text: The IRS budget is the clearest case where politics overrides math. Investing pays returns; cutting costs revenue.

punchline.text: $80 billion given, $72 billion clawed back. Politics beat arithmetic again.

quiz.question: How much net revenue was the $80 billion IRS investment expected to generate?
